name: JW Marriott Costa Elena Resort & Spa, All-Inclusive
positioning: All-suite, all-inclusive beach resort on Playa El Jobo in Guanacaste, Costa Rica, with a Griffin Club hotel-within-a-hotel
best_for: Travelers who want an all-inclusive beach stay in an all-suite resort
Families who want a Kids Club and Family by JW activities
Couples who want Griffin Club privacy and ocean-view suites

facts.text: The resort is set along the shores of Costa Elena in Guanacaste, Costa Rica, as a beach resort.
The resort's address is Playa El Jobo, La Cruz, Guanacaste.
All accommodations are suites, with terraces.
Mindfulness junior suites are offered, including swim-out versions.
The Griffin Club has dedicated lounges and personalized attention.
The Griffin Club Presidential Suite has indoor and outdoor living areas and the highest level of Griffin Club privileges.
Spa by JW offers massages, full-body treatments, express facials, and hair, skin and nail services.
The resort has private pool cabanas.
Family by JW offers nature-inspired activities, creative workshops, outdoor exploration and guided discovery.
The room rate typically includes meals, snacks, alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks, entertainment and non-motorized water sports.
The resort has eleven restaurants and bars.
Boga is a Japanese restaurant guided by the art of gyotaku.

highlights.text: The Griffin Club is a hotel-within-a-hotel offering privacy, elevated service and access to its own suites and private spaces.
Swim-out suites and Griffin Club suites are offered.
The Griffin Club Master Suite Ocean View looks out over the Pacific coastline.
The Kids Club offers a nature-inspired environment where young guests can explore, create and connect.

considerations.text: Spa treatments, motorized water sports, tours and premium items may cost extra.
WhataHotel notes a secluded location, with longer travel times from major airports.
